# nlohmann/json

- **Version**: 3.11.3
- **Source**: https://github.com/nlohmann/json
- **Tag**: v3.11.3
- **License**: MIT (see LICENSE)
- **Vendored on**: 2026-03-28
- **Files**: Single-include distribution (`include/nlohmann/json.hpp`, `include/nlohmann/json_fwd.hpp`)

## How to Update

1. Go to https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases
2. Download the source for the desired release
3. Copy `single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp` and `single_include/nlohmann/json_fwd.hpp` into `include/nlohmann/`
4. Copy `LICENSE.MIT` to `LICENSE`
5. Update the version in this file and in `CMakeLists.txt`
